question: Which of the following dynasties succeeded the Palas of Bengal?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Senas__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Sena dynasty was established by Samantasena, who claimed descent from the lunar dynasty.
 
• Vijayasena, the second ruler of the Sena dynasty, is credited with consolidating the dynasty's power in Bengal, succeeding the Palas.
